connection.text: Connection Name*Give your connection a unique name to help you identify it in the future.PagerDuty*PagerDuty CloudPagerDuty Server (to be supported)If you are using PagerDuty Cloud, you do not need to enter the endpoint URL, which is https://api.pagerduty.com/.Token*ProxyAdd a proxy if you cannot access PagerDuty directly.Custom Rate LimitBy default, DevLake uses 10,000 requests/hour for data collection for PagerDuty. But you can adjust the collection speed by setting up your desirable rate limit. Learn more
